title: Nearby Search
summary: 'Coffee near me' sounds simple, but checking the distance to millions of places on every request is far too slow. Nearby search divides the world into a hierarchy of cells (geohashes or S2 cells), indexes every place by the cell it is in, and answers a query by looking up only the few cells that cover the search circle. Exact distance filtering and ranking then run on that small candidate set.

walkthrough.title: Search near a location
walkthrough.text: The app sends lat 47.6097, lng -122.3331, radius 1 km, query 'coffee', and filters such as open now.

walkthrough.title: Cover the circle with cells
walkthrough.text: The API computes the set of cells covering the 1 km circle at a suitable level. With geohashes, nearby points share a prefix such as c23nb. Neighbouring cells are included so places just across a cell edge are not missed.

walkthrough.title: Look up candidates
walkthrough.text: The geo index returns all coffee places in those cells. The API then computes the exact distance (haversine) and drops anything outside the circle.

walkthrough.title: Load details
walkthrough.text: Names, hours, ratings, and photos for the remaining few hundred candidates are fetched in a batch from the place-details store and cache.

walkthrough.title: Rank
walkthrough.text: Candidates are scored by distance, rating, popularity, open-now status, and personal relevance, not distance alone.

walkthrough.title: Return results
walkthrough.text: The top 20 are returned with a cursor. If too few results are found, the API widens the radius and searches again.

walkthrough.title: Keep the index current
walkthrough.text: New places, moves, and closures from owners and data providers update both the details store and the geo index, re-filing a place under its new cell.

input.name: Results
input.type: Places with distance, rating, open status

responsibilities: Sends the user's location (with permission) and filters.
Re-queries as the map moves, with debouncing.
Shows results on a map and in a list.

failureModes.impact: Results centred on the wrong block.
failureModes.mitigation: Use reported accuracy; let users adjust the pin.
Debounce and cache by cell on the client.

data.label: Nearby Search API
responsibilities: Covers the search circle with cells at the right level.
Widens the radius when results are sparse.

failureModes.scenario: Only searching the user's own cell
failureModes.impact: Misses a café 20 m away across a cell boundary.
failureModes.mitigation: Always include neighbouring cells in the covering.
Finer cell levels where density is high (adaptive, like a quadtree).

output.name: Candidates

responsibilities: Maps each cell to the places inside it.
Uses cell IDs that sort by space, so nearby cells are range scans.

failureModes.scenario: Shard for a big city overloaded
Places near the antimeridian or poles
failureModes.mitigation: S2 cells on a sphere avoid most projection edge cases.
